title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4AGRI - Deployment
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4agri/Deployment. The scenario, including temporal and spatial information, in which the systems and devices are installed. Subclass of ssn:Deployment (W3C SSN, not modeled here). Represents a specific installation of a given agricultural system (e.g. a smart irrigation system) on a sosa:Platform for a given time period and at a given geographical location. See the ex:ArvalisDeployment20162017Land07 example in ETSI TS 103 410-6 clause 4.3.2, Figure 9.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'Deployment'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

deployedOnPlatform.description: Relationship. ssn:deployedOnPlatform some sosa:Platform (inverse: ssn:inDeployment). The relation between a deployment and the Platform in which it is deployed.

deployedSystem.description: Relationship. ssn:deployedSystem some ssn:System (inverse: ssn:hasDeployment). The relation between a deployment and the system deployed (e.g. a WateringSystem or WeatherStation).

deploymentPeriodStart.description: Property. s4agri:hasDeploymentPeriod some time:Interval, time:hasBeginning. The start of the time span during which the system is deployed.

deploymentPeriodEnd.description: Property. s4agri:hasDeploymentPeriod some time:Interval, time:hasEnd. The end of the time span during which the system is deployed.

location.description: GeoProperty. s4agri:isDeployedAtSpace some geo:SpatialObject. The spatial area in which the system is deployed.
